Continued expansion requires operating cash generation to keep covering such outflows.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the 10-K, the 10-Q and the earnings release; the backlog figures are as of fiscal 2025 year-end.
growth_thesis.claim: The underlying demand base is school-district spending. The 10-K says the market is driven by municipal spending, and backlog was approximately 3,070 units at fiscal 2025 year-end versus 4,800 a year earlier. Legacy unit bookings were 6,573 for nine months against 6,892. Growth depends on municipal budgets and orders holding up despite tariff-related pricing uncertainty.

temporarily impacted bus orders during the latter part of fiscal 2025

we produced a large number of units for certain customers that we will recognize as revenue in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026 when the units are delivered to coincide with school resuming
